name: microglia
description: Microglia — a headless feedback flywheel SDK for agentic workflows
author: Lambertyan

scripts.build: tsc -b packages/core packages/memory packages/nl2charts packages/distill packages/apply packages/capture packages/cortex-adapter packages/eval
scripts.clean: tsc -b --clean packages/core packages/memory packages/nl2charts packages/distill packages/apply packages/capture packages/cortex-adapter packages/eval
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/core packages/memory packages/nl2charts packages/distill packages/apply packages/capture packages/cortex-adapter packages/eval
scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm poc:typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm audit:repo && pnpm bench
scripts.poc:live: pnpm poc:llm-reader && pnpm poc:llm-distill && pnpm poc:embedding && pnpm poc:scale
